skills.name: Raise Thrall
skills.text: Raise a corpse within {range} tiles as a thrall with {lifePct}% of your max Life. It strikes for {dmg} Physical damage. You command up to {cap} thralls, one more for every {capEvery} ranks.

variants.name: Bone
variants.text: Raise bone thralls: {lifeMult} times the Life and {armourPct}% more armour, and every {tauntEvery} turns each taunts foes within {tauntRadius} tiles.

variants.name: Ghoul
variants.text: Raise ghouls: they move and strike {speedMult} times as fast, and their hits cause Bleed.

variants.name: Plague
variants.text: Raise plague thralls: each bursts on death for {burst} Blight damage to foes within {burstRadius} tile.

skills.name: Command Sigils
skills.text: Your thralls and other summons gain {thrallLifePct}% Life and deal {thrallDmgPct}% more damage.

skills.name: Bound Wraith
skills.text: Bind a wraith to your will, no corpse needed. It has {lifePct}% of your max Life and casts frost bolts at foes within {boltRange} tiles for {dmg} Frost damage, Chilling them. One wraith serves at a time, and the cooldown starts when it is slain.

variants.name: Banshee
variants.text: Every {wailEvery} turns the wraith wails, Fearing foes within {wailRadius} tiles for {fearTurns} turns.

variants.name: Lantern Wraith
variants.text: The wraith's bolts burn instead: Fire damage that sets foes Burning. Its lantern lights {light} more tiles around it.

variants.name: Twin
variants.text: Bind {count} wraiths at once, each with {twinPct}% of the Life and damage.

skills.name: Corpse Detonation
skills.text: Detonate a corpse within {range} tiles: every foe within {radius} tile takes Physical damage equal to {pct}% of the dead creature's max Life.

variants.name: Chain
variants.text: The blast sets off every other corpse it reaches, each once.

variants.name: Bone Shrapnel
variants.text: Shards of bone give every foe hit {bleed} Bleed stacks.

variants.name: Miasma
variants.text: The blast leaves a cloud of miasma for {turns} turns: foes inside take {cloudPct}% of the blast's damage as Blight each turn.

skills.name: Dark Sacrament
skills.text: Sacrifice one of your thralls within {range} tiles: you heal {healPct}% of your max Life, and {pct}% of its remaining Life strikes every foe within {radius} tiles of it as Physical damage.

variants.name: Offering
variants.text: You restore {manaPct}% of your max Mana instead of Life.

variants.name: Martyred Thrall
variants.text: Your other thralls deal {dmgPct}% more damage for {turns} turns.

variants.name: Soul Bottle
variants.text: The sacrificed thrall rises again at once, at full Life.

skills.name: Grave Pact
skills.text: {sharePct}% of the damage you take passes to your nearest thrall within {reach} tiles.

skills.name: Stitched Colossus
skills.text: Stitch together a colossus of dead flesh with {lifePct}% of your max Life. It strikes for {dmg} Physical damage, and every second attack is a slam that deals {burst} Physical damage to all foes within {slamRadius} tile. One colossus serves at a time, and the cooldown starts when it is slain.

variants.name: Sanguine Effigy
variants.text: Its hits heal you for {healPct}% of the damage they deal.

variants.name: Charnel Golem
variants.text: Every {every} turns it detonates a corpse within {reach} tiles, as Corpse Detonation.

variants.name: Iron-bound
variants.text: It gains {armourPct}% more armour, and every {tauntEvery} turns it taunts foes within {tauntRadius} tiles.

skills.name: Legion
skills.text: You command more thralls: one more at rank 1, two more at rank 3 ({thrallCap} now). At rank 5 your thralls act twice on every {doubleEvery}th turn.

strings.tree.desc: Raise the dead and bind spirits into a small army that fights at your command.
strings.summon.thrall.name: Thrall
strings.summon.thrall.desc: A corpse raised to serve the Occultist. It fights until it falls a second time.
strings.summon.bone_thrall.name: Bone Thrall
strings.summon.bone_thrall.desc: A thrall armoured in its own bones. It draws foes onto itself.
strings.summon.ghoul.name: Ghoul
strings.summon.ghoul.desc: A swift, starving thrall whose claws leave bleeding wounds.
strings.summon.plague_thrall.name: Plague Thrall
strings.summon.plague_thrall.desc: A swollen thrall that bursts in a cloud of rot when it dies.
strings.summon.wraith.name: Bound Wraith
strings.summon.wraith.desc: A shade held to the Occultist's service. It hurls bolts of grave-frost at the Occultist's foes.
strings.summon.banshee.name: Banshee
strings.summon.banshee.desc: A wailing wraith. Its cry sends the living fleeing.
strings.summon.lantern_wraith.name: Lantern Wraith
strings.summon.lantern_wraith.desc: A wraith carrying a cold lantern-flame. Its bolts burn, and its light pushes back the dark.
strings.summon.colossus.name: Stitched Colossus
strings.summon.colossus.desc: A hulk of dead flesh sewn together and given purpose. Every second blow it strikes shakes the ground.
strings.summon.sanguine_effigy.name: Sanguine Effigy
strings.summon.sanguine_effigy.desc: A colossus stitched from blood-soaked flesh. Its blows feed the Occultist's veins.
strings.summon.charnel_golem.name: Charnel Golem
strings.summon.charnel_golem.desc: A colossus raised from the charnel pit. The dead around it burst at its call.
strings.summon.iron_bound.name: Iron-bound Colossus
strings.summon.iron_bound.desc: A colossus bolted into iron plate. It calls foes onto itself.
strings.buff.martyred.name: Martyred Fury
strings.buff.martyred.desc: A kin's sacrifice drives this thrall to greater violence.
strings.zone.miasma.name: Miasma
strings.zone.miasma.desc: A cloud of grave-rot. Creatures inside it are Blighted.
strings.corpse.name: Corpse
strings.corpse.desc: The remains of something slain here. An Occultist could raise it or set it off.
strings.refuse.no_thrall: You have no thrall to sacrifice.
